title: Waystation
description: Waystation artifact repository: requests, cache efficiency, upstreams, jobs, storage and HTTP from /metrics.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Format requests per second answered by the proxy engine (selected repositories).

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of requests in the time range answered from the blob store (HIT, REVALIDATED, STALE) out of all requests.

panels.title: Served from cache
panels.description: Bytes sent to clients from the blob store in the time range: upstream bandwidth saved.

panels.title: Fetched from upstream
panels.description: Bytes downloaded from upstream registries in the time range (cache fills and pass-through).

panels.title: Upstream error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests in the time range that failed because the upstream could not be reached or answered wrongly (cache state ERROR, HTTP 502).

panels.title: Transfers in flight
panels.description: Live transfers right now, summed over the scraped server processes.

panels.title: Requests by cache state
panels.description: HIT: from cache. REVALIDATED: metadata checked upstream, unchanged. STALE: from cache because the upstream failed. FETCHING: miss, this request fetched it. COALESCED: miss, joined another request's fetch. ERROR: failed.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: out_cache: to clients from the blob store. out_upstream: to clients while streaming from upstream. in_upstream: downloaded from upstreams.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio by repository
panels.description: Requests answered from the blob store / all requests, per repository.

panels.title: Upstream errors by repository
panels.description: Requests per second that failed because of the upstream (cache state ERROR). A sustained rate means the repository's upstream is degraded or down.

panels.title: Upstream latency (p95)
panels.description: Time from the upstream request to its response headers, 95th percentile per repository.

panels.title: Request coalescing
panels.description: owner: fetched for others. tail: followed a fetch by streaming its file. wait: waited for the commit. solo: fetched without Valkey coordination. takeover: took over from an owner that went away.

panels.title: Repositories (time range)
panels.description: Per repository over the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum by (repo, format) (increase(waystation_requests_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo",cache=~"HIT|REVALIDATED|STALE"}[$__range])) / sum by (repo, format) (increase(waystation_requests_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Upstream state
panels.description: Per proxy repository: OK, Degraded (failed in the last 10 minutes and not recovered since), Blocked, Offline (switched offline by an administrator). The same rule as the Waystation UI.

panels.title: Upstream rate limit remaining
panels.description: Share of the upstream pull rate limit left (Docker Hub ratelimit-limit / ratelimit-remaining headers), as last reported by the upstream. Only repositories whose upstream reports a limit appear.

panels.title: Upstreams now
panels.description: Current state, failures since the last success and the latest reported rate limit per proxy repository.

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: Workers with a heartbeat in the last 60 s.

panels.title: Scheduler leader
panels.description: Live workers holding the scheduler lease: 1 expected. 0 means scheduled jobs (rollups, cleanup) do not run.

panels.title: Jobs waiting
panels.description: Jobs queued and not yet picked up by a worker, all queues.

panels.title: Jobs running
panels.description: Jobs a worker is running, all queues.

panels.title: Oldest waiting job
panels.description: Age of the oldest job not yet picked up. Grows when workers are down or busy.

panels.title: Dead letters
panels.description: Jobs that failed every attempt (the dead-letter stream). Look at the worker logs.

panels.title: Jobs by queue
panels.description: waiting: not yet picked up. running: delivered to a worker. delayed: retry backoff or a later start time.

panels.title: Oldest waiting job by queue
panels.description: Age of the oldest job not yet picked up, per queue.

panels.title: Free space
panels.description: Free bytes on the filesystem of the data directory.

panels.title: Free space %
panels.description: Free share of the data filesystem.

panels.title: Blob store used
panels.description: Bytes held by blobs, each stored once.

panels.title: Blobs
panels.description: Blobs in the blob store.

panels.title: Writes refused
panels.description: Cache and upload writes refused in the time range because free space would drop below WAYSTATION_MIN_FREE_GB.

panels.title: Metric sources down
panels.description: Sources of the cluster figures (valkey, mongodb, filesystem) that did not answer the last scrape; their figures are missing.

panels.title: Data filesystem
panels.description: free: free bytes. guard: below this, new cache and upload writes are refused. used: bytes held by blobs.

panels.title: Writes refused by the free-space guard
panels.description: Refused cache and upload writes per second.

panels.title: Freed by cleanup and blob GC
panels.description: Bytes removed per interval: asset bytes removed by cleanup policies and blob bytes deleted by blob GC (cluster totals; max over servers).

panels.title: Cleanup and blob GC activity
panels.description: Items removed by cleanup policies, blobs and orphan uploads removed by blob GC, and GC runs, per interval.

panels.title: Assets missing their blob
panels.description: Assets the last blob verify run found without their blob file: hosted ones are lost until uploaded again or restored from a backup (BACKUP.md); proxied ones are re-fetched on their next request.

panels.title: Blob verify findings
panels.description: Per interval: blob verify runs, referenced blobs found missing or damaged, proxied assets marked for re-fetch and hosted assets reported lost.

panels.title: Low-disk guard
panels.description: Whether free space is below the low-disk guard now: new cache fills pass through uncached and uploads are refused (507).

panels.title: Repositories near quota
panels.description: Repositories using 80 % or more of their quota but not yet all of it.

panels.title: Over soft quota
panels.description: Repositories with a soft quota (warns only) that store at least their quota.

targets.expr: count((max by (repo) (waystation_repository_quota_used_ratio{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo"}) >= 1) and on (repo) max by (repo) (waystation_repository_quota_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo",mode="soft"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: At hard quota
panels.description: Repositories with a hard quota that reached it: new uploads are refused and proxy downloads are not cached.

targets.expr: count((max by (repo) (waystation_repository_quota_used_ratio{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo"}) >= 1) and on (repo) max by (repo) (waystation_repository_quota_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo",mode="hard"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Downloads not cached
panels.description: Proxy downloads in the time range served to the client without being cached (hard quota or low-disk guard); each one went to the upstream.

panels.title: Uploads refused by quota
panels.description: Uploads in the time range refused because the repository reached its hard quota.

panels.title: Quota used by repository
panels.description: Stored bytes / quota per repository with a quota. 80 % warns; 100 % is the quota (a hard quota refuses new writes there). Soft quotas can go above 100 %.

panels.title: Not cached and refused
panels.description: Per second, per repository: proxy downloads not cached by reason (quota, low_disk) and uploads refused by a hard quota.

panels.title: Repositories with a quota
panels.description: Quota, mode, stored bytes and use per repository with a quota now; downloads not cached and uploads refused for the quota in the time range.

panels.title: API latency (p95) by route
panels.description: Server time per request, 95th percentile, per REST API route template.

panels.title: HTTP requests by status class
panels.description: Every HTTP request the server answered (format, API, health; not the event stream), per status class.

panels.title: Event-stream clients
panels.description: Connected live event-stream (SSE) clients, all server processes.

panels.title: Routes (time range)
panels.description: Per route template and method over the selected time range.
